title: Astro Portal API v1 — the integrations of a multi-night plan
description: An integration is one line Astro Sync sends for one night, one target and one family of frames (filter, exposure, gain, binning, temperature): how many frames it integrated and for how long. It is metadata only — never a file: the masters stay on the computer that made them. Integrations hang under a multi-night plan (`project.schema.json`, « projet » internally): `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/integrations` lists them with their totals by filter, `PUT` adds or replaces them (idempotent per night, target and family) and, with `replace`, sends a night's lines for a target as a complete set, removing the ones no longer sent. Reading never needs a capability; writing needs the multi-night plans of Astro Sync (`analysis.progression`, « Synchronisation avancée+ »), and is always refused on a private server. See api/v1.md, « Integrations of a multi-night plan ».

eveningDate.description: The calendar date of the night's evening (`YYYY-MM-DD`), the date the night is named by: its plan's date, or the evening of its start at the place's longitude (never a time zone).

filter.description: The filter as the frames name it, never normalised; `null` for frames without a filter (« Sans filtre »).

write.description: One integration as Astro Sync sends it. The family is `filter`, `exposureSeconds`, `gain`, `binning` and `temperatureC`; with `nightId` and `targetId` it is the key of the line: sending the same key again replaces the line. `totalSeconds` is never sent: the service computes it (`frameCount × exposureSeconds`).

nightId.description: The night (`sessionId`, the observation session) the frames were taken in.

sensor.description: The sensor (`INSTRUME`, or the night's equipment).

computerLabel.description: The label of the computer Astro Sync runs on (« iMac du bureau »): where the master is kept.

installationId.description: Astro Sync's installation on that computer: tells « on this computer » from « on another computer ».

set.description: A set of lines: everything one night holds for one target. Listed in `replace`, the set is sent **complete**.

integration.description: One integration as the service keeps and lists it. `source` says who wrote the line — `declared` (the service, from the debriefing of a night attached to the multi-night plan: one line per target of the plan, family key `declared`, `filter` null unless the debriefing named one) or `measured` (Astro Sync's `PUT`); absent means `measured`. `sessionId` is the night's session, the **same value as `nightId`** (the word the Journal uses). A declared line is **replaced** by the measured lines Astro Sync sends for the same night and target; a declared line whose frame count is not known has `frameCount: 0` and `exposureSeconds: 0`, and `totalSeconds` is then the declared time, stored (for every other line it is computed). Reading the declared lines needs no capability.

totalSeconds.description: Computed: `frameCount × exposureSeconds` (a declared line with an unknown frame count: the declared time).

filterTotal.description: The integrations of one filter added up over the nights, computed by the service, in the order the filters first appear (the earliest night first).

declaredSeconds.description: The part of `totalSeconds` that is still **declared** (no measured line replaced it yet).

measuredSeconds.description: The part of `totalSeconds` that Astro Sync measured. `declaredSeconds + measuredSeconds = totalSeconds`.

planTotal.description: One filter's line of the image of a multi-night plan, as Astro Sync declares it (the nights it combined).

planCapture.description: The image of the multi-night plan (`uploads.md`, role `plan`): the newest capture Astro Sync sent for the plan, with the nights it combined and its totals by filter. It is a capture of the space beside the nights' captures: it belongs to no night, and it is no variant of a night's capture.

render.description: The render Astro Sync applied: `natural` (« Rendu naturel »), `dualband` (« Correction bibande »), `polished` (« Rendu soigné »), `hoo` (« Palette HOO »), `none` (« Sans traitement »); `null` when it did not say. Not Astro Sync's pipeline ids: its pipeline `raw` is « Rendu naturel », `natural` here.

oneOf.description: The body of `PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/integrations`, earlier form (what the clients that predate `replace` send): one to 200 integrations, added or replaced, **none removed**.

The body of `PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/integrations`, complete form: `replace` names the (night, target) sets sent **complete**. The service replaces the measured lines the plan holds for each set by the `integrations` received and removes the ones not sent any more (the declared lines are the service's own and stay). `integrations` holds 0 to 200 lines — none empties the sets — and each belongs to one of the listed sets (a line outside them, or a set listed twice, is `400 invalid_request`). One transaction: all or none. A service that predates `replace` answers `400 invalid_request` (unexpected property), and the client then sends the earlier form.
`GET` (and the answer of `PUT`): every integration of the plan, the earliest night first, and their totals by filter.

A refusal. `403 multi_night_not_active` (no `analysis.progression`, a subscription in its read-only window, or a private server, where the multi-night plans of Astro Sync never run) names the capability; `409 integration_outside_night` gives the night's own `eveningDate`; `409 integration_night_not_in_project` (a night that does not belong to the multi-night plan: the `PUT` writes only for the plan's own nights; carries `nightId`) is checked after the capability gate and before `integration_outside_night`; `404 project_not_found`, `404 session_not_found` (the night), `400 invalid_request`.
